comingLast.roast: the rescue mission: 2 points, 5 holes, no pressure at all
clear of Sutton by 1 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
the gap is 3 - close enough that his mates ordered him a blue drink as a joke
4 above Sutton - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
4 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
the buffer reads 7 - his group reads it aloud each tee
